messages.en:
{07 16 00}People always tell me that
plain clothes look good on
me. {01 00 00 0a 00}But as Fashion Lad...
{07 06 00}I gotta shake things up
with clothes that are a
little {01 00 00 05 00}dangerous.
{07 00 00}But I gotta say, there's a
fine line between risky and
tacky, you know?
{07 13 00}I wish someone would just
give me a daring outfit as
a present{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}. Hint hint.

veidi {01 00 00 05 00}ohtlikud.

riietuse{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}. Vihje vihje.
